Good home design starts with more than an attractive floor plan. It requires careful consideration of circulation, proportion, function, exterior form, and how the spaces will work together over time. Poulsen Home Design by Mont Poulsen provides Home Design Services for homeowners planning New Home Construction and custom residential projects. Through Drafting And Design, Mont can develop concepts into clear, detailed plans that help communicate the intended structure, layout, and architectural character of a home. Architectural Drafting Services can support the transition from an initial idea to a more defined design that is ready for the next stage of the building process. Modern Design often depends on clean proportions, purposeful openings, strong connections between interior and exterior spaces, and efficient use of natural light. For a smaller footprint, Small House Design requires another level of planning so every square foot contributes to comfort and function. Poulsen Home Design also provides Exterior Home Design, House Exterior Design, and Home Exterior Design to create a cohesive visual identity from the street to the interior. If you’re researching a Home Designer, Home Draftsman, Architectural Drafting, Drafting Services, or Utah Home Design, talk with Mont Poulsen about your project and the vision you want to bring to life.

Black Mold vs. Common Household Mold: What’s the Difference? 🏠 Many homeowners become concerned whenever they see dark spots on walls, ceilings, or around moisture-prone areas. While people often immediately assume black mold is present, not every dark-colored mold growth is actually black mold. Several types of mold can appear inside homes and may vary in color, texture, and growth patterns. Mold develops when moisture remains trapped in building materials for extended periods. Leaks, humidity problems, flooding, and poor ventilation can all create ideal conditions for growth. Some molds appear green, gray, white, or black, making visual identification difficult without proper testing and inspection. The larger concern is often not the color itself but the moisture source allowing mold to grow and spread. Any mold issue should be addressed quickly before contamination expands into surrounding areas. If you suspect mold inside your property, contact Superior Restoration for professional mold inspections and remediation services.

From the owner
Loose doors and leaking faucets can cause more stress than most people expect. We recently helped a property in Albany, Oregon where a door hinge kept coming loose and a faucet was dripping at the worst times. For the door, the original screws had stripped the wood, so we installed longer screws into fresh material for a solid hold. The faucet was leaking due to a cracked aerator adapter, so we replaced it with a new part to stop the drip. Small fixes like these can make everyday life smoother. If you have a similar issue, reach out to see how we can help.
Oct 10, 2026
